text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—An Umamusume fan's morning starts early. 
On this day, Agnes Digital was running in 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She just desperately wanted to see her 
absolute favorites, TM Opera O and Meisho 
Doto, battling it out together up close...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digital tries to hold back her overflowing 
excitement. She runs with complete 
seriousness so as not to disrespect her 
idol. That is her personal code.
